Welcome

Understanding public life through the voices of ordinary citizens.

Wenfang Tang is a political scientist whose research examines public opinion, political culture, and mass politics, with a sustained focus on China and comparative politics.

He is Presidential Chair Professor and Dean of the School of Humanities and Social Science at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen.

His scholarship connects large-scale survey research with enduring questions about political trust, participation, identity, and institutional change.
